title: Realizing open exponent-p idèle class quotients as norm groups over a field containing the p-th roots of unity
author_responsibility: Original statement and proof by J.S. Milne. The author attribution to Tate (1976, 5.2) is preserved.
material_provenance: Author PDF v4.03 checked editorial TeX. Exact original main proof and author support kept as separate spans.
difficulty_reason: The author constructs the Kummer extension from S-units and identifies its global norm subgroup with a product of local p-th powers and unramified units, by matching the p^s global degree with the ratio of local and S-unit power indices. This exact subgroup controls arbitrary open exponent-p quotients.

dedup.scope: CFT VII.5.1 (900008206) bounds the global norm index of a given Galois extension. Stacks 900005879 produces a cyclic extension from a root in the Kummer correspondence. VII.9.3 realizes an arbitrary open subgroup with an exponent-p finite quotient by an exact norm subgroup construction.

readability.basis: All three compiled pages and the selected original page regions checked; a single omitted p restored at the exact source formula.

source_caveats: Preserve the primitive p-th root hypothesis, openness and finite quotient killed by p. The proof uses local power-index formula, Kummer correspondence and global reciprocity. The full subsequent VII.9.5 is separately held because it omits openness in its printed statement.

Original VII.9.3 displays the index denominator and then calculates the numerator. The separately attached original VII.9.2 applies to its exact S and identifies the denominator; footnote 7 belongs only to VII.9.2.
Preserve the original printed wording at the local unramified step and the original exponent-p wording. The p factor was restored only in the derivative, against physical 234.
